what: Single-owner reconciliation of the pilot's stored ClickHouse LLM spans (run cafae810). Every model call was stored twice: a Vigil gen_ai.chat span and, as its direct child, the anthropic SDK's native anthropic.messages.create span with the same model, tokens and cost. A plain SUM over the stored rows doubles the spend; bench/span_accounting.reconcile excludes only the proven native copies and returns the per-unit Postgres totals exactly. The raw rows were not rewritten.

provenance.method: bench/span_accounting.py reconcile (read-only SELECTs over the stored spans of run cafae810-f2e9-4c50-b34d-cfac8b18c509), run through the pilot's verify checks on 2026-10-25 after the SDK fix (0e68bd9); Postgres OK-unit totals read alongside
derived_from: historical-accounting-verification.json (owner's validation workspace, outside the repo): per-version reconcile output + Postgres totals; original pilot files confirmed unchanged
trace-accounting-root-cause.json (same workspace): raw span count and the native/Vigil pairing census
provenance.reproduce: engine/.venv/bin/python bench/span_accounting.py cafae810-f2e9-4c50-b34d-cfac8b18c509 --postgres (needs that run's rows in your own ClickHouse/Postgres; a fresh clone has neither, so this committed record is what demo/evidence.py cross-checks against the bundle)
